correctness.rationale: Exact four-site energy-change identity gives all allowed local exchanges. A finite triple-context adjacency matrix counts cyclic words by trace. Every context reaches an all-equal state, each all-equal state reaches every context, and self-loops guarantee primitivity. Colour-orbit averaging gives a 5x5 quotient, with exact characteristic polynomial. The unique simple Perron root yields asymptotic trace coefficient one. Independent checker passed 300 tests over exact characteristic values, quotient transitions, exhaustive site energies and finite traces; it does not substitute for the infinite proof.
